effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, if during an attack, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much DP as this Digimon or less.
[Your Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, this Digimon may digivolve into a [Chronicle] trait Digimon card in the hand or trash.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to 1 of your [Chronicle] trait Digimon.
